speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of your eyes and skin. To determine the cause, how many weeks old are you, and is your mother Rh-negative or have you had a blood type incompatibility?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Late-Onset Jaundice).

The clinical picture of a healthy, term infant with significant weight gain and exclusive breastfeeding presenting with worsening jaundice after the first week is classic for this condition. I will order a Total Serum Bilirubin test to confirm the level and ensure it is not reaching dangerous thresholds requiring phototherapy.
